nom: St. Ives Blackhead Clearing Face Scrub

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including a few who specifically bought it for oily, blackhead-prone areas, report it clears excess oil and blackheads and leaves skin matte rather than greasy; one reviewer with an oily nose says it helps there only to an extent and works better as a first step before a nose-pore patch.
segments.dry: One reviewer says the scrubbing texture works fine for dry skin as well.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say it works well across their face, including on an oily T-zone, without feeling too rough; one recommends following up with a lightweight moisturizer on drier areas.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one who found the St. Ives apricot scrub too harsh, report this scrub does not irritate, dry out or aggravate their skin, even with occasional hormonal breakouts.
segments.mature: A couple of reviewers mention it working well for aging skin, including one who says her skin looks a little more youthful with regular use, though details are limited.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers mention it working well for aging skin, including one who says her skin looks a little more youthful with regular use, though details are limited.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it cleans without leaving skin feeling tight, stripped or dry; a couple of dissenting reviews note their skin feels a little dry afterward and recommend following with a moisturizer or lotion.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers say it calms redness after use, including one who specifically credits it with visibly reducing redness.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports a reduction in the spots on her face after about a week of use, alongside smoother-feeling skin.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers say it clears or reduces blackheads and helps prevent new breakouts, including one whose esthetician was surprised how few blackheads she had, and several who saw fewer blackheads within a few uses to a couple of weeks; dissent includes reviewers who say it did not clear their nose pores despite consistent use, did not remove existing acne, or left old acne scars and some blackheads still visible.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report it pulls out excess oil and dirt and leaves skin matte rather than greasy after use, including one who specifically bought it for oily, blackhead-prone skin and calls it a staple.

aspects.libelle: Fresh green tea scent, widely liked
Finer, gentler grit than the classic Apricot scrub
Contains synthetic dyes despite natural marketing
Great value for the size and price
Some bottles arrive unsealed or leaking
Texture feels too rough for a few users
Works well as a short leave-on mask

extraits.texte: Like the smell & that it "claims" to be salicylic acid, bamboo, & green tea. Does not clear my pores, even after sweating 2.5 hrs. in gym or running + 3-5x wk. use. Poor strips have been only products that clear my nose pores.

This face scrub acts to an extent on the nose, but not to the fullest degree–probably because I have an oily nose. I like using it as a prep step, and then following up with an overnight nose patch for blackheads, which really does the trick. It works well for the rest of the face, and doesn’t leave my skin feeling raw or stripped. Instead, my face feels clean and refreshed. If you have combination skin like mine, definitely follow it up with a lightweight moisturizer. Overall, a gentle option that fits nicely into a multi-step routine.

extraits.titre: Keeps skin refreshed, but It doesn’t clear off previous acne scars.
extraits.texte: I like this product, it keeps my skin feeling good and refreshed after use. However i wouldn’t say it manages my acne the best, I don’t have new breaks but not all of my previous acne scars are gone neither is all of the acne gone, but it is something.

I'm typically not a huge fan of St. Ives scrubs as the apricot scrub is way too harsh for my sensitive skin, it always felt as though it was tearing my skin apart and not helping to exfoliate at all. I was researching scrubs and came across a plethora of products, all of which were ridiculously priced. I was looking for a gentle scrub, but not too gentle. This product is perfect! It almost feels like a microdermabrasion. The exfoliant is extremely fine, feels almost like baking soda and it's loaded with it! Not too gentle and not too harsh. The color has a light green tint to it, looks almost like pea soup. The scent is citrusy, very pleasing. After using the product, my skin was extremely smooth! I used a toner and moisturizer following the exfoliation and OH MY GOODNESS! I can't say enough positive things about this scrub. My skin looks clean, fresh, dewy, and just down right healthy! The price is phenomenal for such an awesome scrub. Do yourself a favor and don't waste your money on more expensive scrubs, this one works just as well if not BETTER than some of the top of the line ones. I'm sold, will use this forever as long as they continue to sell it.

extraits.titre: A Lifesaver for Oily, Blackhead-Prone Skin!
extraits.texte: As someone with oily skin that gets shiny within minutes of stepping outside, especially in hot weather, I've struggled with blackheads for years. That's why I'm thrilled to have found this face scrub - I'm now a three-time repeat buyer! This green tea and bamboo-infused scrub is a game-changer for my oily, blackhead-prone skin. It effectively clears existing blackheads and helps prevent new ones from forming. After using it, my skin feels fresh and matte, not greasy. The salicylic acid in the formula is great for controlling oil and treating acne, while the natural exfoliants provide just the right amount of scrubbing action. My pores look visibly clearer and my skin feels smoother after each use. What impresses me most is how it balances being tough on blackheads and excess oil while still being gentle on my skin. The refreshing green tea scent is a bonus, especially on hot days when I'm prone to oiliness. If you have oily skin that's prone to blackheads, especially in warm weather, I highly recommend giving this scrub a try. It's been a staple in my skincare routine, and I can't imagine dealing with my oily skin without it!

extraits.titre: This works really well, even for sensitive and aging skin!
extraits.texte: I have been using this exact scrub for a few years now and I love how it works perfectly for my part sensitive, part mixed complexion. I use it once or twice a day. The bamboo and green tea scent is mild, and the scrub doesn't dry out my face. It's one of the few skincare products that do not aggravate my occasional hormonal acne flares. After I first started using it, an esthetician friend, when I asked for an extraction with my facial was surprised that I didn't have a lot of blackheads — And I think I can attribute that to this product. It doesn't hurt that the product is affordable and that a little goes a long way. You truly do not need more than a pea-sized amount per wash. Naturally, a solid 5 out of 5 stars. :)
Love the scent very easy to wash off. Great texture lol but leaves my face dry a bit afterwards I have to apply lotion after on nose after.
